title: NPDev Gaps & Roadmap Ledger
description: gaps-ledger.v2: all v1 entries (31 priorityIndex + 12 fixedEngineBugs) were DONE/CLOSED and archived to git history. The v2 format is a clean slate reserved for future cross-cutting gaps that don't fit a single ledger item. scripts/ai/extract_platform_status.py and scripts/docs/generate_gaps_roadmap.py consume this file.

notes.description: Human-readable context about the ledger state, migration history, or format reservations.

entries.description: Cross-cutting gaps that don't fit a single ledger item. Empty when all known gaps are resolved.

title.description: Short human-readable description of the gap.

opened.description: ISO 8601 date when this gap was filed.

closed.description: ISO 8601 date when this gap was resolved.
